scenes.locationDetail: Trok's beach shack north of town
scenes.aiSummary: Kaleho visits Trok; Orden asks them to find his missing daughter Hiyasa.
The next morning, Ryu joins the search and Nerissa introduces herself.
Abelard recalls Hiyasa seeking an ancient tomb upriver.
Ryu reports that Blu has found a trail along the river.
The party follows recent tracks upriver until nightfall.
The party camps and keeps three uneventful watches.
A deserted one-person camp leads to a trail away from the river.
The party follows the cut trail through dense forest for most of the day.
The party reads the tomb inscription, scouts the roof, and climbs toward the open entrance.

scenes.locationDetail: Entrance shaft and upper mosaic hall
scenes.aiSummary: A blade trap and a fall injure Trok and Kaleho during the descent.
The party destroys four gargoyles before they can fully activate a snake-headed statue.

scenes.locationDetail: Upper mosaic hall and locked side door
scenes.aiSummary: The party examines the statue, gathers stone keys, follows tracks, and heals.

scenes.locationDetail: Small side chamber and connecting stairs
scenes.aiSummary: Tracks lead past a connecting passage and down the staircase.

scenes.locationDetail: Lower corridor with a mud trap
scenes.aiSummary: The party detects a mud-filled stretch and crosses using jumps and pitons.

scenes.locationDetail: Inscribed chamber above the inner sanctum
scenes.aiSummary: Lightning strikes Kaleho; crawling beneath the crystals allows the party to descend.
Hiyasa is trapped in stone; a speaking guardian rejects the party’s oceanic offerings.
The stone guardian traps the party in mud and fells Trok before Ryu destroys it.
Ryu revives Trok, Nerissa teleports free, and Trok escapes the hardening mud.

scenes.locationDetail: Inner sanctum and six gem-topped jars
scenes.aiSummary: Hiyasa explains her treasure map after being caught taking loot; the party examines the jars.

scenes.locationDetail: Tomb exit and return route to Hamri
scenes.aiSummary: The party retraces the traps, conceals the entrance, and carries the recovered treasure back to Hamri.

scenes.locationDetail: Return to Hamri several days later
scenes.aiSummary: Wazir examines the treasure; the party divides gold, gives Nerissa the pearl, and leaves Wazir the ancient papers.

entities.label: Orden
entities.aiSummary: Orden asks Trok and Kaleho to find Hiyasa, his daughter, who has not returned from an upriver treasure hunt.

entities.label: Hiyasa
entities.aiSummary: The party rescues Orden’s daughter from a stone guardian and questions her about her treasure hunt. She shares a sketch of three tomb sites and receives a finder’s fee.

entities.label: Abelard
entities.aiSummary: The hungover storyteller recalls Hiyasa seeking treasure in an ancient tomb upriver.

entities.label: Blu
entities.aiSummary: Ryu’s osprey companion scouts the trail and tomb and helps fight both sets of guardians.

entities.label: Yerkir-khor
entities.aiSummary: Inscriptions and mosaics identify the tomb’s earth-lord and depict his powers, worshippers, and trade. The party never meets Yerkir-khor himself.

entities.label: Stone guardian of Yerkir-khor’s tomb
entities.aiSummary: An unnamed speaking stone guardian demands tribute and rejects offerings associated with the ocean. It fights the party with stone and mud magic until Ryu destroys it.

entities.label: Azar
entities.aiSummary: The party recalls Azar’s earlier crimes and his convalescence with the lizardfolk.

entities.label: Benat
entities.aiSummary: The opening discussion recalls Benat taking Azar to a lizardfolk village to recover.

entities.label: Airion the Mistspeaker
entities.aiSummary: The opening discussion recalls the ancient scholar whose research Azar had followed.

entities.label: Sentient Ocean
entities.aiSummary: The opening discussion recalls the stolen living water used in Azar’s earlier experiments.

entities.label: Hiyasa’s treasure map
entities.aiSummary: Hiyasa sketches three ancient tomb sites from a map she saw, including this tomb and two unexplored locations.
entities.note: Campaigns/Mawar Adventures/Items and Treasure/Hiyasa's Treasure Map.md

entities.label: Snake-headed statue in the upper hall
entities.aiSummary: A large snake-headed statue has jeweled eyes, gold bands, and a removable arm gem that the gargoyles try to pull. The party leaves the gem in place.

entities.label: Gargoyles’ stone keys
entities.aiSummary: The party collects four stone keys from the shattered gargoyles and uses one to open the door behind the statue.

entities.label: Kaleho’s crossbow of warning
entities.aiSummary: Kaleho’s magical crossbow warns him as the gargoyles attack and remains his weapon against the stone guardian.

entities.label: Ryu’s returning spear
entities.aiSummary: Ryu repeatedly throws his returning spear at the gargoyles and the stone guardian, delivering the final blow against the latter.

entities.label: Kaleho’s merfolk artifact
entities.aiSummary: Kaleho offers a treasured, worn merfolk-associated object as tribute, provoking the guardian’s hostility.

entities.label: Nerissa’s teleporting sword
entities.aiSummary: Nerissa uses a charge from her sword to teleport free of the hardening mud.

entities.label: Six gem-topped funerary jars
entities.aiSummary: Six large stone jars behind the tomb contain treasure and strange substances, which the party examines and carries away.

entities.label: Pearl of power
entities.aiSummary: The small pearl recovered from a jar is eventually identified as a pearl of power and given to Nerissa.

entities.label: Ancient Texts of Yerkir-Khor
entities.aiSummary: Magical yellow dust preserves a sheaf of extremely old papers in an unreadable language. The party entrusts them to Wazir for later deciphering.
entities.note: Campaigns/Mawar Adventures/Items and Treasure/Ancient Texts of Yerkir-Khor.md

entities.label: Obsidian-topped bottomless jar
entities.aiSummary: The obsidian-topped jar swallows a shell without returning it or revealing a bottom. The DM later establishes that it shattered upon leaving the tomb.

entities.label: Ancient coins and uncut gems
entities.aiSummary: Ancient dwarven coins and uncut gems from the jars provide approximately 600 gold in treasure, divided with a 60-gold finder’s fee for Hiyasa.

interactions.aiSummary: Orden describes Hiyasa’s disappearance and persuades Trok and Kaleho to search upriver.

The party discusses whether to give more of its shares to Orden after Hiyasa’s finder’s fee.

Abelard recalls Hiyasa leaving to investigate a tomb and expecting to return after a few days.
Hiyasa warns the party about the guardian and escapes the mud with Nerissa’s inspiration during the battle.

interactions.aiSummary: Blu helps Ryu find and follow the trail upriver.
Blu helps track the route and scouts the tomb roof before the descent.
Ryu directs Blu’s diving attacks against the gargoyles.
Blu repeatedly attacks the stone guardian while staying out of the mud.
The entrance inscription names Yerkir-khor and his titles.

quotes.text: Here lies Yerkir-khor the undaunted Prince of earth lord of the Rock below and guardian of the crystal skies.

interactions.aiSummary: An inscription promises wisdom to the faithful and entombment to intruders.
The mosaics depict an earth-lord receiving tribute, and his guardian demands offerings in his name.
The guardian demands tribute and rejects shells, a pearl, and Kaleho’s merfolk artifact.

interactions.aiSummary: The party fights and destroys the guardian after it traps adventurers in mud and knocks Trok unconscious.

interactions.aiSummary: The opening discussion recalls Azar’s defeat and planned recovery among the lizardfolk.
The conversation recalls someone caring for Azar back home.
The opening discussion recalls Benat taking Azar to the lizardfolk village.
The opening discussion identifies Airion as the older elemental scholar whose clues Azar followed.
The opening discussion recalls Azar stealing a fragment of the Sentient Ocean.
Orden remembers Hiyasa carrying maps and notes about ruins with treasure.
Hiyasa sketches three sites from the map she saw while explaining her treasure hunt.

interactions.aiSummary: Two unexplored marks remain on the map, and Hiyasa offers more information for payment.
The party notices the statue stirring as a gargoyle works its gem, examines it afterward, and leaves a warning note.
The party gathers the gargoyles’ keys and opens the locked side door.
The crossbow’s warning lets Kaleho react as the gargoyles attack.
Kaleho shoots the guardian while restrained in a stone hand.
Ryu’s spear returns after his throws and destroys a gargoyle attempting to activate the statue.
Ryu rushes the guardian and delivers the killing blow after it fells Trok.
Kaleho offers his treasured merfolk artifact, angering the guardian further.
Nerissa expends a sword charge to teleport out of the hardening mud.
Six gem-stoppered jars stand behind the central statue.
After stopping Hiyasa from taking treasure, the party opens the jars and investigates their contents.
Kaleho inspects the small pearl but initially finds nothing unusual.
The pearl is identified as a pearl of power and assigned to Nerissa.
A yellowish glowing substance and dust are found in the yellow-topped jar.
The dust is found to preserve ancient papers, which are left with Wazir to decipher.

interactions.aiSummary: The party drops a shell into the apparently bottomless jar and cannot recover it.
The DM establishes retrospectively that the obsidian jar shattered when carried out of the tomb.
The party finds unfamiliar ancient coins and uncut quartz and amethyst in the jars.
The coins are recognized as ancient dwarven money and roughly 600 gold is divided into Hiyasa’s 60 and four 135-gold shares.
